QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_63

question.text: For currency futures and options contracts involving Indian Rupee, what rate is used as the final settlement price?

answer.text: FBIL (Financial Benchmarks India Pvt Ltd) reference rate on the last trading day
RBI reference rate published at 12:00 noon on the last trading day
The closing price of the futures contract on the last trading day
The last half-hour weighted average price on the last trading day

explanation.text: The Logic: The settlement-price table on page 166 specifies the FBIL reference rate on the last trading day as the final settlement price for currency futures and options contracts involving the Indian Rupee. The Trap: The last half-hour weighted average price is the daily settlement (MTM) input, not the final settlement input; the two should not be conflated. Note: Daily settlement uses the last half-hour weighted average price, while final settlement uses the FBIL reference rate — two different benchmarks for two different settlement types.
